The draft claims that Saltcombe Rovers dominated the early stages of the match, which contradicts the fact that Duskvale Wanderers took a commanding 2-0 lead from the penalty. Additionally, Saltcombe Rovers dominated possession, which is supported by the fact, but they are credited with missing chances, when the fact states they had big chances. The latter part inaccurately portrays Duskvale as struggling initially, when they actually had less possession and fewer shots in the first half.
